title: test-reduce: certified-redundant boundary cases go to probation by default
description: Plugin-eval rerun of shop-reduce (2026-09-26, /tmp/test-skills-plugin-eval/20260926-214412): with-plugin runs lost 0 kills but kept 73-90 PR cases; one agent kept 28 cases the certificate called redundant 'on purpose for money code', treating demotion as loss. Probation still runs them nightly. Decision (agent, on the user's goal of radical reduction with adequate coverage): demote by default; keeping one in the PR tier needs a stated reason.

acceptanceCriteria.text: test-reduce stage 2 says certified-redundant cases, boundaries included, are demoted by default and each PR-tier keep needs a named reason
Rerun results recorded in the evaluation story

finalSummary: test-reduce stage 2 now demotes every case the certificate removes by default, boundaries and money cases included, because probation still runs them nightly. A PR-tier keep needs --keep and a reason the mutant set cannot express. The rerun (shop-reduce, 3 runs per arm) is recorded in the evaluation story: with the plugin, PR tier 73/90/86 and 0 lost kills; without it, 87/88/75, with two runs losing 4 and 3 kills. Delivered in the PR that closes this task.
